steps.title: Recover native-produced journal after canonical history refusal
preconditions: Existing save-failure-recovery assertions pass in the isolated persistent automation workspace. Local default origin is http://127.0.0.1:1. Host history inode ownership and write refusal are verified and restored before relaunch.
Native execution results are recorded separately in docs/testing/coverage-goal-20261113.md. No malformed/conflicting journal, destructive discard, crash-durability or nonmatching-text apply claim.
actions: text script-editor-mara-line existing-text-plus-two-spaces with owned history write refusal
text Find a project Synthetic save recovery
snapshot wait recovered sheet dismissed and workspace-tabs hittable
activate Use current saved line as base
snapshot wait recovered sheet dismissed and workspace-tabs hittable
text Find a project Synthetic save recovery

expectations.description: Full native-produced journal retains original model/UTF-16 edit; cold reopen preserves bytes, public comparison shows exact current and draft, keep retains bytes, explicit rebase independently changes base/edit, successful reviewed save clears journal without changing canonical model/history, repeated reopen has no recovered dialog. Apply is disabled for the original stale base and becomes enabled/hittable only after explicit rebase.
